title: Larval resting posture key
source: Standard entomology teaching key: Culicinae larvae (Culex, Aedes) breathe through a siphon and hang at an angle below the surface; Anophelinae larvae lack a siphon and lie parallel to the surface. See ECDC, Guidelines for the surveillance of native mosquitoes in Europe (2014), larval identification section: https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/publications-data/guidelines-surveillance-native-mosquitoes-europe

posture.question: How do most larvae rest at the surface?

siphon.question: Can you see a short breathing tube at the tail end touching the surface?

results.culex_or_aedes_type: Culex-type or Aedes-type larva (hangs from a breathing tube)
results.anopheles_type: Anopheles-type larva (lies flat, no breathing tube)
